These four regression decks are copied without modification from
`NetlistViewer/tests/` in https://github.com/f18m/netlist-viewer at commit
`35b37128c0dc844e1acf816c9528340498d9836a`.

Licenses and source notices are retained in `src/vendor/netlist-viewer/`.
